dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000pvwf](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000pvwf) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Feb 27 2025 9km NE of Ratmate. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 27.8265 longitude 85.9676. It impacted 289469 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
